entities.name: Daibutsuyō
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Daibutsuyō  is a Japanese religious architectural style which emerged in the late 12th or early 13th century. Together with Wayō and Zenshūyō, it is one of the three most significant styles developed by Japanese Buddhism on the basis of Chinese models.
